LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADVERBS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs, part of Strand 9 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Where do you live? 2. How do you do your work? 3. When do we come to school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. distinguish adverbs of manner, time and place for effective communication,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use adverbs of manner, time and place correctly in both oral and written sentences,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. realise the importance of adverbs in oral and written communication.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. distinguish adverbs of manner, time and place for effective communication,

   Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. use adverbs of manner, time and place correctly in both oral and written sentences,

   Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. realise the importance of adverbs in oral and written communication.

   Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. play games that involve grouping adverbs of manner, time and place,

2. recite poems containing adverbs of manner, time and place,

3. construct sentences using adverbs,

4. listen to a story or poem read by the teacher or from audio recordings and respond to questions,

5. create word lists of adverbs and use them to construct sentences on a word processor or a web page. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. play games that involve grouping adverbs of manner, time and place,
2. recite poems containing adverbs of manner, time and place,
3. construct sentences using adverbs,
4. listen to a story or poem read by the teacher or from audio recordings and respond to questions,
5. create word lists of adverbs and use them to construct sentences on a word processor or a web page. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: This is manifested when the learner play games involving categorising different

types of adverbs collaboratively.

• Self-efficacy: This is gained when learner constructs sentences using adverbs for daily communication.

70

Values:
Integrity: This is nurtured when the learner displays honesty as they create a list of adverbs and construct sentences

individually.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

HIV and AIDS Education, Communicable and Non-communicable Diseases: These issues are enhanced as the learner

interacts with the theme in various activities and makes sentences with adverbs that are derived from the theme of HIV and

AIDS.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner applies the knowledge gained from studying adverbs to their learning of word classes in Kiswahili.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:

1. distinguish adverbs of manner, time and place for effective communication,
2. use adverbs of manner, time and place correctly in both oral and written sentences,
3. realise the importance of adverbs in oral and written communication.

Remember the key question: Where do you live? 2. How do you do your work? 3. When do we come to school?
